title: NASA's Hubble and Webb discover ancient worlds that remember their past
caption:
By combining observations from Hubble and Webb, astronomers detected 27 ancient planetesimals orbiting past Neptune. Remarkably, their pristine colors suggest these icy remnants have survived billions of years without the heavy collision damage scientists expected.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA's Hubble and Webb discover ancient worlds that remember their past

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261031221209.htm
